notes.title: Murder Is Game Over Series Retrospective – Part 1
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/92d01e216e79e6660b894f6601cd3cc2b3ee871e.png[/img]

After developing and releasing 3 “Murder Is Game Over” titles in 2 years, I’ve had some time to pause and reflect on what I like most about each one. These are my thoughts on the series as a whole.

Best exploration – Murder Is Game Over

My initial concept for this game was to have a murder mystery that emphasized exploration much more inspired by RPGs than adventure games. In hindsight, the world design from the first game was well done in terms of giving the player freedom to move around the world at their choosing. The map shape is based on a series of interconnecting circles including the castle's ground floor, connecting the second floor and the sealed wing, and finally, a secret passage connecting the castle to the surrounding countryside. The method of murder also relies heavily on the way the map makes a seemingly inaccessible area easy to reach through a clever shortcut. Not only is the exploration mechanic effective for the player, but it also serves as part of the storytelling and narrative.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/7f80e1fc4e2a5ded79aded636f18e96e6a8fc179.jpg[/img]

Which game in the series has my favorite villain? Find out in part 2 coming next!

I'm creating the fourth game in the series. Please wishlist it (link below). Thank you for your support!
Matt

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3046150/Murder_Is_Game_Over_The_Blackinton_Curse

notes.title: ⚙️ New game mechanic in Murder Is Game Over: Deal Killer 🕵️‍♂️
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/f71305e0bbe3dec1e1167ae3ca37bed63cee3161.png[/img]

❄️🏔️ With Murder Is Game Over: Streaming Death I wanted to introduce the idea of being chased around by a “ghost” like in Scooby-Doo. In the second half of that game, Elias Abel (actually the killer in disguise) randomly appears while exploring and moves toward the player. The easy difficulty mode is very straightforward. The hard difficulty mode also randomizes the time before the ghost appears so that it’s much more unexpected. The world map is designed to provide lots of opportunities for being chased, and lots of space to maneuver around an aggressive ghost.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/62d5658c8707f1a3c64a2b2448238df54f425b36.png[/img]

With Murder Is Game Over: Deal Killer instead of going big, the concept was to go small spaces. I wanted the player to get the feeling of claustrophobia and being stuck in a small hotel with nowhere to go. There’s little room for a ghostly crook to hide or sneak around. So this concept got me thinking about what other mechanics I could use for a hero or villain to trick people.

That’s how I came up with the new costume mechanic for this new game in the series. Just because there’s no space to hide doesn’t mean there aren’t other ways that a person can be deceptive. Partway through the game, our detectives discover a trove of costumes that Guy can wear as a disguise. The disguises will prompt instances of mistaken identity and different (sometimes extremely silly) reactions from suspects. The costume theme might also play an essential part in how the crime was committed, and how the detective solves the case. 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/c0bbc39daa2f9f9c6e11d1e3089836e51eac9dbc.png[/img]

Do you prefer being chased around a village by a spooky ghost, or being stuck in a mountain top chalet during a blizzard with nowhere to go? As the Murder Is Game Over series continues to evolve, my goal is to come up with different gameplay concepts and mechanics that make each title feel different and unique. 🥸

Thanks for reading!

Matt (indiedev of Murder Is Game Over series) 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478850/Murder_Is_Game_Over_Deal_Killer/

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/f04cdeb45806f663071ac4257586bb1dab3712a2.gif[/img]

The highly-anticipated game, ​Iron Dungeon, is set to captivate gamers worldwide as it announces its official release date of October 3, 2023, at 2 PM EDT. Developed by ​R​_Games, Iron Dungeon promises an unparalleled gaming experience that combines the best elements of roguelike, platformer, and twin-stick shooter genres.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2083910/Iron_Dungeon/?utm_source=steampost

Iron Dungeon is a thrilling amalgamation of genres that will immerse players in a challenging underground world filled with danger, excitement, and relentless action. Players will assume the role of combat clones tasked with exploring a mysterious underground military complex. Their mission: to find a way to the surface and uncover whether life still exists on Earth.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/b1575efd400a35af050b3f8d8b8250f6d628539f.gif[/img]

[b]Key Features of Iron Dungeon
[/b]

Roguelike Challenge: Iron Dungeon offers an exhilarating roguelike experience, with randomly generated levels that keep players on their toes. No two playthroughs are the same, ensuring endless replayability.

Platforming Precision: Navigate treacherous platforms, activate jump boosters, and demonstrate your precision and agility as you explore every corner of the complex.

Intense Twin-Stick Shooting: Engage in heart-pounding battles with hordes of enemies, using a diverse arsenal of weapons and gadgets. Dodge bullets, aim well and show your mettle in the face of danger.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6138946/e20d82dedb38bf4dc8d02886d1c95d053d4c9020.gif[/img]

Exclusive Launch Discount: To celebrate the game's release, Iron Dungeon will be available for just $9.99 USD, with an enticing 10% discount for the entire first week. Wishlist today so you do not miss the discount. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2083910/Iron_Dungeon/?utm_source=steampost

notes.title: Now you can choose the difficulty level!
notes.content:
The choice of difficulty does not affect the damage inflicted or received and the number of opponents, as it would be too banal. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085504/f5d87a68fa0eb26d14443634425101794eb60487.png[/img]

From now on, before the start of a new run, the following game modes are available to you:

EASY MODE
[list]
[*] More nanoparticles for killed enemies.
[*] Implants do not damaged.
[*] You can take up to five extra lives.
[*] An extra life completely restores health.
[*] Medical terminals restore up to five health points.
[/list]

CLASSIC
[list]
[*] Implant damaged if an extra life is spent.
[*] You can take up to three extra lives.
[*] An extra life restores only part of your health.
[*] Medical terminals restore up to three health points.
[/list]

CHALLENGE
[list]
[*] The chance of damage to the implant when taking damage.
[*] You can only take one extra life.
[*] An extra life restores only part of your health.
[*] Medical terminals restore up to two health points.
[*] Ability is not restored if you do not have batteries.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor update v. 1.01/1.02
notes.content:

notes.title: Version 1.0 is available!
notes.content:
Hello, friends!
I am glad to announce that version 1.0 is now available!
This means that the main work is finished and the REPLIKATOR has finally reached a full release.
For nine months in early access, the game has undergone significant changes and has become better thanks to everyone who shared feedback with me!

Some changes in the v. 1.0 update:
- Added secret rooms (look for special buttons on the walls).
- New challenge arenas. (you can get there through a portal that opens under certain conditions)
- Добавлена система дополнительных наград за прохождение уровней.
- The balance has been heavily redesigned.
- Added the final boss.
- The maximum number of implants has been increased to 15.
- Now, after activation of replication, there is a possibility of failure of the implant when receiving damage.
- During boss battles, the implant can also be damaged.
- Redesigned some implants and weapons, including VCG10000.
- Fixed a large number of bugs.
- Small visual improvements.
- Many other changes and improvements.
- Localization into Spanish. In the future, I hope to add other localizations.

The work continues.
I plan to release new updates in the future, including bug fixes, game balance improvements, and possibly adding new content.

notes.title: Update v. 0.978
notes.content:
I think some of you have noticed that no new updates have been released recently. The fact is that working on the game takes a lot of time and effort, so I took a little vacation.
Now that I've had some rest, I'm going back to developing.

This small update mainly includes bug fixes and performance improvements on weak computers.

- Fixed incorrect display of markers on the map.
- Now, when you run the game on a laptop, a discrete video adapter is selected. (IAnyway I hope so)*
- Performance optimization.
- Buying a level map now requires one battery instead of two.


*If the game slows down on a laptop with a discrete video card, then you need to go to the video card settings and manually set the game to start using a discrete video adapter.
(Nvidia Control Panel or Catalyst Control Center)

notes.title: REPLIKATOR is Now Available to Play!
notes.content:
REPLIKATOR is a fast Top Down Shooter with roguelike elements, inspired by the games Nuclear Throne and Dead Cells.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1576370/extras/short_11.08__online-video-cutter.com_.gif?t=1628766414[/img]

[b]Why Early Access[/b]
The experience of publishing demo versions has shown how useful feedback from interested players is. Since the publication of the first demo version, the game has been transformed by an order of magnitude!
I don't know how it happens in big studios, but when you work on a game alone, you just miss a lot of things or deliberately ignore them. Players notice all these nuances and point them out.
And now the moment has come when the demo versions are not enough to get adequate feedback.
Thanks to early access, I want to perfect the balance, add even more content and game situations, and of course, complete the story.

[b]What is ready at the moment[/b]
- More than 30 different enemies.
- More than 30 types of weapons with generated characteristics
- More than 70 implants.
- More than 20 generated levels.
- 4 bosses.
- The system of increasing the difficulty after successful runs (5 iterations of difficulty).

In fact, this is a completely ready-made game with a considerable amount of content, in which it is quite possible to spend several tens of hours.
But I do not intend to stop there! Therefore, the game will be expanded and improved in every possible way!
I sincerely hope that you will like the game and you will help me make it better!

If you have previously played the demo version, then I recommend starting a new game for a better gaming experience! :)

[url=https://discord.gg/CjvPpJF5]Join our Discord server![/url]
